name: ellyseum-dreams
description: GPU-accelerated personal blog with WebGL shaders, SPA navigation, and on-device AI chat

scripts.inject-all: npm run inject-context && npm run inject-chunks && npm run generate-site-config && npm run generate-taglines && npm run generate-config
scripts.build: npm run inject-all && npm run typecheck && vite build && mkdir -p _data && cp assets/js/dist/.vite/manifest.json _data/vite-manifest.json
scripts.clean: rm -rf _site assets/js/dist src/data/taglines.ts src/data/context-chunks.ts src/data/jocelyn-context.ts src/data/site-config.ts about/index.md _config.yml CNAME .jekyll-cache .jekyll-metadata _data/vite-manifest.json
